text:
maria: Quick note — PM wants Console to expose routing headers and fallback reason in request traces so customers can debug why a request dropped from premium->standard or fell back to smaller variant.

jon: +1. Which headers exactly? we already log region & tier but not variant/fallback flags.

lee: We do emit: X-RWD-Tier, X-RWD-Region, X-RWD-Variant, X-RWD-Fallback-Reason but it's only in internal logs. Not in trace payload to Console right now.

maria: can we plumb those into the trace proto? PM wants them visible in the trace timeline and the "why did this route change" tooltip. Also wants a toggle for pii-safe view.

anya: question — retention and quota impact? adding headers to every trace increases payload size.

kevin: rough numbers: +~80 bytes per request, with sampling at 1% that's fine. If full retention for 30d, cost delta ~2% for logs storage. I'll get exact calc.

jon: telemetry: we should record structured counters for fallback_reasons so we can dashboard top reasons (capacity, model_incompat, region_limit, quota).

lee: agree. Also need a compact enum for reasons: CAPACITY, INCOMPAT, REGION_FAIL, QUOTA, LIVE_ROLLOUT. avoids freeform string churn.

maria: UX: show the header timeline (left col) and in detail pane show the routing decision tree + "fallback chain" with timestamps.

kevin: implementation note: we currently generate fallback_chain in routing-service. easiest is to serialize it into trace.attributes as a small JSON array and redact any ip/host fields.

anya: +1 for redact. also add a role-based toggle: show sensitive headers only to admin org users.

jon: For model variant, we should display both requested_variant and served_variant. That will show quantized fallbacks.

infra-bot: deploy bot: Canary rollout id=cr-42 applied to routing-service; change includes: emit X-RWD-Variant to trace proto. started at 2024-05-17T15:12Z :rocket: 

lee: infra-bot noted. I'll wire the ingest to Console. Two questions: 1) sampling — do we ingest all or badge sampled? 2) backward compatibility with old traces?

maria: sampling: by default respect existing trace sample rate. we need a switch to "capture-on-error" to always capture traces that resulted in fallback to cheaper variant.

jon: capture-on-error sounds good. we can set rule: if fallback_reason != NONE then set sample=1 for that request.

kevin: I can add that toggle in routing config + emit an event metric so we can alert on spikes in fallbacks.

anya: UI wiring thoughts: show a small pill in trace header: Tier: premium -> standard (fallback: CAPACITY). clicking expands chain. Also add a link to "Replay route decision" to start a playback job.

maria: replay link is product ask; for now surface it as 'start diagnostic' that pings SE tool.

lee: PR plan: 1) routing-service: include compact header & fallback enum in trace proto 2) ingestion: accept new attrs 3) Console: trace pane + pill + admin toggle 4) metric & alert

jon: estimate: routing + ingest ~2w, Console UI ~1w, metric/alert ~1d. total ~3w.

kevin: I'll mock cost impact in infra deck and include numbers for exec.

maria: ok let's assign: lee -> routing-service proto + ingest, jon -> Console front-end, kevin -> metrics/cost, anya -> privacy gating & RBAC. I'll follow up in ticket.

jon: can we get a quick sample header format for the UI mock?

lee: paste sample:
```
X-RWD-Tier: premium
X-RWD-Region: eu-west-1
X-RWD-Requested-Variant: base-fp16
X-RWD-Served-Variant: base-quant-v2
X-RWD-Fallback-Reason: CAPACITY
X-RWD-Fallback-Chain: ["base-fp16","base-quant-v2","base-small"]
```

maria: nice. add note: redact actual model names for public customers? maybe show abstract variant ids.

anya: yes, show obfuscated ids for non-admin orgs.

infra-bot: deploy bot: Canary cr-42 finished (100% success). logs: no errors.

kevin: I'll post cost calc later today.

maria: thanks all. I'll create the ticket and attach this thread. :eyes:
